evidence.fact: get_obs captures RGB and joint_action/vector; the latter concatenates left/right get_arm_jointState output.
_take_picture calls get_obs and saves numbered frame pickle; merge_pkl_to_hdf5_video converts those frames.
Expert move captures before its control sequence, at configured save_freq during execution, and after the sequence. Recorded frame cadence is not automatically the policy command cadence.
get_left/right_arm_jointState reads joint.get_drive_target()[0] and appends normalized gripper value.
get_left_arm_real_jointState is a separate function that reads articulation qpos; get_obs does not use it for joint_action/vector.
Frames are appended in numeric filename order, RGB encoded into fixed-width byte strings, and other arrays written without an action temporal shift.
Collection uses seed.txt[episode_idx] in setup_demo, loads _traj_data/episode paths, stores scene_info, merges HDF5 after play_once and asserts success.

conclusions.joint_action_vector_semantics: contemporaneous commanded arm drive targets plus normalized gripper values, not measured physical joint qpos
conclusions.temporal_shift: none introduced by the archive writer; a training converter must state its future-target alignment explicitly
conclusions.reason: No simulator replay has run; archive has no HDF5 root attributes or separately listed configuration/source-version file, and seeded reset compatibility must be verified against actual author configuration. Trajectory pickle was not loaded.
